errors.evidence: The chart does not provide a numerical value for the blue slice ("Няколко пъти месечно"). The machine incorrectly infers the value to be 9.1%, while it should be smaller, as the two unlabeled slices (blue and red) together account for approximately 9% of the total.

The chart does not provide a numerical value for the red slice ("Всеки месец"). The machine incorrectly infers the value to be 9.1%, while it should be smaller, as the two unlabeled slices (blue and red) together account for approximately 9% of the total.

errors.text_span: Всички процентни стойности са изписани вътре в съответните сектори.
errors.evidence: This statement is false. Percentage values are only written on four of the six sectors. The blue ("Няколко пъти месечно") and red ("Всеки месец") sectors do not have their values displayed on the chart.

errors.text_span: а останалите четири са с по 9,1%
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly claims that the four smallest slices are all 9.1%. In fact, only two slices are labeled as 9.1% (purple and light blue). The other two (blue and red) are smaller and do not have this value.
